notes_for_editor: The only tower-specific source is the register page, which has no build date, design, height, agency or access line. Two WebSearch queries (one with the Eleanor McCain name) found no news or agency record. The Cheaha Bunker Tower near Delta is a different stone structure and is not used. The brief says standing; the register does not state current condition, so status_note records that. The reconstruction caption is undated, so no rebuilt event is recorded. Ownership is the register's administrator line only; the story does not call the site private. Worth asking the register contact for a build date and the reconstruction date before publishing.
